City of Encinitas
City Council - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, JUNE 24, 2015 -
6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS Parks Make Life Better Proclamation. Contact Person: Parks and Recreation Commission Chair Kohl
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a "WHITE" speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two (2) Council Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a "PINK" speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the 6/10/15 Special Joint Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2015-06-24 Item 8A - Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants.
2015-06-24 Item 8B - Warrants
8C.
City Council Policy for Integrated Pest Management. Contact Person: Park and Beach Superintendent La Riva
Approve City Council Policy C031 Integrated Pest Management.
2015-06-24 Item 8C - Integrated Pest Management Report
8D.
Legislative Position Letters. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst McSeveney
Approve the legislative position letters for the Mayor's signature.
2015-06-24 Item 8D - Legislative Position Letters
8E.
Approval of two-year agreement between the City of Encinitas and Sun Life Financial/National Joint Powers Authority (NJPA) for Group Life, Accidental Death and Dismemberment (AD&D), Optional (Supplemental) Life and Long Term Disability (LTD) Insurance Services for City of Encinitas and San Dieguito Water District employees. Contact Person: Human Resources Department Manager Dunphy
Approve the renewal of a two-year agreement between the City of Encinitas and Sun Life Financial/National Joint Powers Authority (NJPA) for Group Life, Accidental Death and Dismemberment (AD&D), Optional (Supplemental) Life and Long Term Disability (LTD) Insurance Services with no plan changes for City of Encinitas and San Dieguito Water District employees.
2015-06-24 Item 8E - Sun Life Financial Agreement Renewal
8F.
Consideration and possible action regarding negotiating a potential lease agreement with Intrepid Theatre Company (Intrepid) to build a performing arts theatre on Lot 16 at the Encinitas Ranch Town Center (Performing Arts Theatre), including the possibility of executing an Exclusive Negotiating Agreement (ENA) and hiring Keyser Marston Associates (KMA) to assist in the process of all negotiations. Contact Persons: Mayor Gaspar and Deputy Mayor Blakespear
1) Negotiate and execute an ENA in substantial form; and 2) Hire the services of KMA, advisors in public/private real estate development, to assist in the process of all negotiations, at a cost not to exceed twenty-five thousand dollars ($25,000), consistent with the KMA proposal dated June 12, 2015.
2015-06-24 Item 8F - Intrepid Subcommittee Report
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Public Hearing to consider the introduction of draft City Council Ordinance No. 2015-10, titled "An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, California, adopting an amendment to Title 9; Public Safety, Peace, and Health of the Encinitas Municipal Code by adding a new Section 9.23 to regulate the retail sale of dogs and cats in the City of Encinitas." CASE NUMBER: 15-089; APPLICANT: City of Encinitas; LOCATION: Citywide. Contact Person: Associate Planner Winter
Delay action on this draft ordinance pending the outcome of the lawsuits discussed in this Agenda Report. Should the Council wish to proceed, staff recommends the following: 1) Consider the information in the Agenda Report; 2) Open the public hearing and receive and consider public testimony; and 3) Introduce, with modifications as determined necessary, City Council Ordinance No. 2015-10 titled, "An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, California, adopting an amendment to Title 9; Public Safety, Peace, and Health of the Encinitas Municipal Code by adding a new Section 9.23 to regulate the retail sale of dogs and cats in the City of Encinitas."
2015-06-24 Item 10A - Public Hearing Ordinance 2015-10 Retail Sale of Dogs and Cats
10B.
Status and direction on Assembly Bill 744 (Chau) Density Bonus. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst McSeveney
1) Remove opposition to Assembly Bill 744 (Chau) at the author's request; or 2) Approve the modified opposition letter that accounts for recent amendments to the bill.
2015-06-24 Item 10B - Assembly Bill 744 Density Bonus Status
10C.
Review and Allocation of the City of Encinitas and Mizel Family Foundation Community Grant Program Application Requests for Fiscal Year 2015/16. Contact Person: Arts Administrator Gilliam
Approve the Evaluation Panel's recommended funding allocations and make any desired additional allocations.
2015-06-24 Item 10C - Mizel Family Foundation Community Grant Program Allocations
Grant Applications - Attachment 3
10D.
Consideration and possible action regarding adopting a Mediation Program for land use/development and general disputes. Contact Persons: Subcommittee Members Deputy Mayor Blakespear and Council Member Kranz
Direct the City Manager, in consultation with the Subcommittee, to move forward in bringing back a voluntary mediation program, regarding land use/development and general disputes, for Council consideration and possible adoption based on the concepts identified in the report.
2015-06-24 Item 10D - Mediation Subcommittee Report
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
12.
COUNCIL MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM
12A.
Council initiated item from Council Members Kranz and Shaffer regarding continued consideration of public safety and downtown issues.
2015-06-24 Item 12A - Council Initiated Item

17.
ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
